The inline native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell chrome native-safe: loading -> dimmed skeleton box (web Skeleton h-full rounded-xl); error -> centered danger-toned message (web QueryError centered, native-safe); else GlassPanel with a title-aware header (title present -> icon+uppercase muted title left + DataFreshness right; title absent/compact -> DataFreshness right-aligned only, matching the web shell's two branches) over the children body. DataFreshness is a native pill: relative 'updated' time with Updating…/Error/stale(warning) markers + a refresh Pressable wired to onRefresh — the web DataFreshness/PinButton/HelpTooltip surfaces are browser-only and stay owned by WidgetShell's own future turn.
